method: per-expectation violating-row recount over the extract the pipeline consumed (read_files on dbfs:/Volumes/ow_tp/mig_1793185083/ow_tp_invoice_quality_extract/*.csv) vs the rows each quarantine sink tagged with that expectation's reject_reason; the pipeline's own evaluation is the deployed code under review, so the recount is the independent leg
source_extract: dbfs:/Volumes/ow_tp/mig_1793185083/ow_tp_invoice_quality_extract/{invoice_line,invoice_header,customer_master}.csv (literal SELECT-only extract of OW_BILLING.INVOICE_LINE/INVOICE_HEADER/CUSTOMER_MASTER, unfiltered = full estate; refreshed this run: 18750 / 150000 / 25001 rows)

expectations.name: line_has_header
expectations.pass_predicate: INVOICE_ID IS NOT NULL AND INVOICE_ID IN (SELECT INVOICE_ID FROM OW_BILLING.INVOICE_HEADER)
expectations.implemented_as: LEFT ANTI check in src/invoice_quality.py: lines whose invoice_id is NULL or absent from deduped headers carry 'line_has_header' in reject_reasons -> invoice_line_quarantine

expectations.name: line_invoice_dt_parseable
expectations.pass_predicate: INVOICE_DT IS NULL OR try_to_date(INVOICE_DT, 'dd-MMM-yy') IS NOT NULL

expectations.name: header_invoice_dt_parseable
expectations.pass_predicate: INVOICE_DT IS NULL OR try_to_date(INVOICE_DT, 'dd-MMM-yy') IS NOT NULL

expectations.name: header_due_dt_parseable
expectations.pass_predicate: DUE_DT IS NULL OR try_to_date(DUE_DT, 'dd-MMM-yy') IS NOT NULL

expectations.name: cm_signup_dt_parseable
expectations.pass_predicate: SIGNUP_DT IS NULL OR try_to_date(SIGNUP_DT, 'dd-MMM-yy') IS NOT NULL

notes: reject_reasons may carry multiple reasons per row; every sink row's reason set was exploded for the tagged counts (invoice_line 37 tagged rows = 37 rows, invoice_header 0, customer_master 50)
